name: PhotoCraft
tagline: The open-source image editor you already know how to use
blurb: Layers, masks, adjustment layers, layer styles, type, vectors and brushes in a native app written entirely in Rust.
description:
PhotoCraft brings professional photo and raster editing to an open-source, native application written entirely in Rust.

Featuring layers, masks, curves, adjustment layers, typography, vector shapes and customizable brush engines with PSD compatibility. Works completely offline with zero telemetry and zero cloud round-trips.

install.label: Cargo / Build from source
install.command: git clone https://github.com/storytold/photocraft.git && cd photocraft && cargo run --release -p photocraft
install.note: Pure Rust native app. Also compiles to WebAssembly.
